text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... This makes it... our third showdown.
However...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I feel like for the first time,
I was able to compete against the real Crimson Nova...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The past of being crushed will never change.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The sky is the same color as it was that day—
yet somehow, it looks a little different.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Furioso's doing pretty well for herself.
Her running was on point today, too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, looks like there are some incredible Umamusume over in Funabashi too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The strength of the JRA is absolute"âthat common sense of the Umamusume world found a faint crack in its bedrock, brought by Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text: ...Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ms. Crimson Nova...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: You're finally speaking to me on your own, are you?

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because this year—
I won't be competing against you anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Crimson Nova's expression as she said that seemed slightly softer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You are... the symbol of the Central that must be defeated.
That will never change.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "However, I've come to understand your feelings a little. And the burdens you carry, too."

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
I see...
You have learned of the cross we bear.

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
An ace from the Central must not lose to the Local circuit.
Because the Central stands above the Local. However...

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
That's purely in terms of overall race record.
It's quite tough...

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
Furioso, being expected to beat
an Umamusume like you every time is just too much.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ms. Crimson Nova...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The absolute Crimson Champion.
In her heart—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The run from the challenger from Funabashi
seemed to have reached them loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
Until next year, then. You won't be satisfied
unless you beat me at Funabashi, will you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even knowing your position,
defeating you at the Funabashi Racecourse is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—It is a rite of passage.
A ritual for every Umamusume in Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"In order to believe in our own potential once more
and make a fresh start,
we will be returning this."

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
"Then I accept your challenge.
But before that..."

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text: You said you understood how I felt a little, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, I did say that.

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
However, I don't fully understand it yet.
Most likely, that is...

text_block_list.name: Crimson Nova
text_block_list.text:
You'll come to understand in time.
Once you've attained strength equal to mine, further down the road.
—Farewell for now.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Will I find out... from here on...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crimson Nova walked away. With that,
Furioso safely concluded the three-race stretch.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Man, Furi-pyon was amazing today! I feel like I got a burst of energy just watching her~

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, at first I tried to think that only Furi-chan was special, but...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: "I'm starting to think that maybe we can do this after all!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's not like I'm anything
special or anything.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's all do our best, step by step.
Funabashi's Umamusume and Trainers together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our challenge was set to continue. But
we desperately wanted other Umamusume to follow suit.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer.
About our next target race, I suppose—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "Could it be the Diolite Kinen? To settle our score once and for all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's not that I haven't considered that, of course, but—
choice_data_list: There's a race I want to enter before that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso is no longer an unknown Umamusume.
She's one of the leading figures of the dirt division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then there is a grand race in February of next year that is fitting for just that.
choice_data_list: Let's go with the February Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes...
A GI race held at Tokyo Racecourse in February...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It is one of the major races that everyone knows, but...
choice_data_list: Let's enter that as one of the main stars!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Defeating Crimson Nova is crucial, but
we must not forget our aim to become the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
One of the leading stars...
That's right. Starting next year, you'll be in the Senior Class, and the younger generation will be looking up to you as a goal.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then from the February Stakes
to the Diolite Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's focus is still locked
on her archrival, Crimson Nova.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the February Stakes, she would likely have to compete against newly rising rivals as well.
